caption: Firka Fortress, Chania
composition: Western harbor bastion and maritime-museum building · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Firka bastion closes the west end of Chania’s old harbor: a thick honey-stone wall with arched gun ports and the long building at the entrance that houses the Maritime Museum of Crete. The view is from the quay, with small boats in front. Midday is partly cloudy, cloud cover about 47 percent, about 22.6°C, and dry. The harbor lighthouse and the mosque are outside this frame.
